maya: Quick ask — for the seed launch landing + webinar, I sketched an anchorgraph for internal linking + redirect plan. Can SEO + content weigh in? Want to lock redirects/UTMs before final draft. TL;DR: prioritize 3 CTAs, add topic clusters, schema for webinar & benchmark narrative. Attaching draft.

sam: Looks good. Need keyword gating: primary KW sets per cluster. I'll add page-level targeted KW map. Also confirm we want schema type WebinarEvent + Article for benchmark narrative? :thinking_face:

liam: Agree on WebinarEvent + Article. For the benchmark narrative we should add a short 'measurement' section and PR-friendly FAQ schema for expected Qs.

maya: Here’s rough redirect rules (dev-friendly):
```text
# Redirects
/seed-webinar -> /launch/seed-webinar?utm_source=seed
/seed-post -> /blog/seed-launch-benchmark?utm_source=seed
```
Can we map old CTAs to these?

sam: +1. Also add canonical tags and ensure rel=prev/next for multi-part narrative. Small snippet for WebinarEvent schema: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebinarEvent","name":"Seed Launch Benchmark","startDate":"2026-04-15T17:00:00Z"}
```

arya: I'm updating copy. For internal links: anchorgraph should surface 'Benchmark findings' and 'How to integrate' pages from landing. Can we make top nav anchors link to #findings and #howto?

liam: For redirects, prefer 301 permanent. dev please implement:
```nginx
rewrite ^/old-cta$ /launch/seed-webinar?utm_campaign=seed permanent;
```
Also ensure the server retains query params (preserve original UTM when possible).
